outlook.statement: Forecasts for spunlace nonwovens indicate healthy growth; Smithers projects CAGR 2025-2030 at 8.8% in tons, 9.8% in square meters, 9.5% in market value. Spunlace is the fastest-growing nonwovens process in 2020-2030 period. Global FMCG landscape for wet wipes and cosmetic products expected to witness steady but structurally transformative growth between 2026 and 2031.

Non-woven segment growing 8-9% per annum; spunlace non-woven comprises 12% of total non-woven, likely to reach 14% by 2028. Growth outlook positive but success depends on differentiation, quality stability, and application-focused product design.

India wet wipes market expected to grow at ~6.4% CAGR to reach over USD 3.4 billion by 2030. Broader personal care wipes segment expanding with strong traction in baby care, intimate hygiene, and cosmetic wipes. India beauty and personal care market projected to reach ~$27 billion by 2029.

Global wet wipes market projected to expand at 2.7-3.8% CAGR; personal care wipes growing faster at ~6% CAGR. Sustainability-led innovation, biodegradable/compostable substrates, functional benefits (antibacterial, dermatologically tested), and digital commerce driving adoption.

The Company does not expect any material financial impact on its financial statements upon implementation of the said Labour Codes. The Company will continue to monitor further developments, including finalisation of rules and clarifications by the authorities, and will give appropriate effect in the financial statements, if required, in future periods.
